info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Business Analysi By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve detailed business analysis reports based on specific channel portfolio parameters. The primary resource is the business analysis data, which is essential for stakeholders involved in strategic decision-making and performance evaluation. Common consumers of this API include financial analysts, business intelligence teams, and risk management professionals. By utilizing this endpoint, teams can gain insights into various aspects of business performance tied to selected channel portfolios, aiding in data-driven strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific channel portfolio by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific channel portfolio identified by its unique ID. It is useful for understanding the various metrics and attributes associated with that portfolio.
